allele.extrabees.bee_species.copper.desc: "Smells of green patina and old pennies."|Extra Bees
allele.extrabees.bee_species.coal.desc: "Leaves sooty footprints on every flower."|Extra Bees
allele.extrabees.bee_species.redstone.de: "Buzzes with a faint electric hum."|Extra Bees
allele.extrabees.bee_species.lapis.desc: "Deep blue like a night over the sea."|Extra Bees
allele.extrabees.bee_species.diamond.des: "Cuts through everything, including your patience."|Extra Bees
allele.extrabees.bee_species.emerald.des: "The villagers will trade anything for it."|Extra Bees

allele.extrabees.bee_species.netherite.d: "Remembers a world before this one."|Extra Bees
"Hums the sound of distant guardians."|Extra Bees

allele.extrabees.bee_species.brass.desc: "Gears turn better when it hums."|Extra Bees

allele.extrabees.bee_species.ambrosium.d: "Floats a little when nobody is looking."|Extra Bees
allele.extrabees.bee_species.zanite.desc: "Gets stronger the more it is used."|Extra Bees
